snippet.title: Decide humanity's fate in Quarantine Zone: The Last Check | Coming 2025 🧟‍♂️
snippet.description:
Play the Demo, Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3419520/Quarantine_Zone_The_Last_Check/

Command the last blockade from the zombie horde, inspect survivors, and decide their fate: safe haven, quarantine, or elimination. Expand your base, upgrade defenses, and fend off hordes. Every step shapes humanity’s survival. Your choice matters and every mistake costs a life...

Follow Quarantine Zone: The Last Check
Discord: https://discord.gg/quarantinezonegame
X/Twitter:  https://x.com/BG_QZone
Instagram:   https://www.instagram.com/quarantine_zone_game
TikTok:   https://www.tiktok.com/@quarantine_zone_game
